name: Greediness
overview: Scripture warns strongly against greediness, identifying it as a form of idolatry that corrupts both personal character and spiritual inheritance. The Bible teaches that covetousness troubles one's household and is incompatible with the holiness expected of believers, as seen in Ephesians and Colossians. Jesus cautions that life’s true value does not lie in material abundance, urging contentment with what God provides, reinforced by the promise of His unfailing presence in Hebrews.
